title: Hot Honey Pizza: A Cannabis Pizza Recipe
h1: Hot Honey Pepperoni Pizza with a Canna-Oil Crust
metaDescription: A homemade pepperoni and jalapeño pizza with canna-oil kneaded into the dough and an optional canna-honey drizzle, with clear per-slice dose math.
excerpt: Sweet heat meets a canna-oil crust: pepperoni, jalapeño and a drizzle of hot honey. The dough makes two pizzas, so bake one and freeze the other.
keyTakeaways: Canna-oil goes into the dough, which you split into two equal balls.
Divide each ball's THC by eight slices for a per-slice estimate.
Use one dose point at a time: plain hot honey on an infused crust, or canna-honey on a plain one.
Freeze the second dough ball with a label that says infused, the date and its mg.
body:
This cannabis pizza recipe bakes the infusion into the crust: canna-oil kneaded into a simple dough, topped with pepperoni, jalapeño and mozzarella and finished with hot honey. The dough makes two 12-inch pies.

## How this cannabis pizza recipe doses by the slice

Total the canna-oil in the dough, divide by two dough balls, then by eight slices. With oil estimated at 32 mg per tablespoon, 2 tablespoons give 64 mg: about 32 mg per pizza and 4 mg per slice at most. Weigh the balls so they match.

Use one dose point at a time. On an infused crust, drizzle plain hot honey; save [canna-honey](/blog/canna-honey/) for a plain or lightly dosed crust, measured per slice. Have one slice, then wait 2 hours.

## Ingredients and method

Bloom the yeast in warm water with a pinch of sugar, mix in the oils, flour and salt, knead until smooth, and let the dough double in size. Divide it, stretch one ball, add sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and jalapeño, and bake on a preheated stone or sheet at 450°F. Finish with honey warmed with red pepper flakes, plus parmesan. Our [canna-oil recipe](/blog/canna-oil-recipe/) covers the infusion, and you can order flower ahead for curbside pickup at [your nearest store](/shop/).

## Storage and labeling

Freeze the second dough ball in an oiled bag labeled "infused," with the date and its mg. Refrigerate leftover slices in a labeled container and eat them within 3 to 4 days. Keep it all away from kids and pets; poison control is 1-800-222-1222.

## Swaps

Go vegetarian with mushrooms, peppers, red onion and olives. With store-bought dough, brush measured canna-oil evenly over it before topping. Pair it with our [herbed grilled cheese](/blog/herbed-grilled-cheese/) for a comfort-food spread.

Adults 21 and older only. Enjoy it responsibly.

faq.a: No, not wholesale. The oven air is hot, but the inside of the crust stays far cooler and the bake is short. A lab study of THC brownies found baking didn't degrade the THC. Some loss is still possible, so read your per-slice number as a ceiling.

Yes. Let it come to room temperature so it stretches easily, then brush a measured amount of canna-oil over the stretched dough, right to the edges, before the sauce goes on. Divide the oil's estimated mg by your number of slices.

Yes. Once it has doubled, oil the ball lightly, seal it in a freezer bag and label it with the date, the word infused and its estimated mg. Thaw it overnight in the fridge and let it sit out for an hour before shaping.

ingredients: 3 1/2 cups all-purpose or bread flour, plus more for dusting
2 tablespoons canna-oil (or the amount your dose math calls for)
2 tablespoons honey per pizza (plain, or measured canna-honey on a plain crust)
1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes, plus more to taste
steps: Stir the yeast and sugar into the warm water and let it stand 5 to 10 minutes, until foamy.
Add the olive oil and canna-oil, then the flour and salt, and mix into a shaggy dough.
Knead on a floured counter for 8 to 10 minutes, until smooth and springy.
Place in an oiled bowl, cover and let it double in size, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Divide into two equal balls, weighing them to be sure. Freeze one, labeled, if you're baking a single pizza.
Heat the oven to 450°F with a pizza stone, steel or upside-down baking sheet inside for at least 30 minutes.
Stretch one ball into a 12-inch round on parchment. Spread the sauce and add the mozzarella, pepperoni and jalapeño.
Slide it onto the hot stone and bake 12 to 15 minutes, until the crust is browned and the cheese bubbles.
Warm the honey with the red pepper flakes, drizzle it over the pizza, scatter parmesan and cut 8 equal slices.
recipe.dosingNote: An estimate, slice by slice. Example: 2 tablespoons of canna-oil at about 32 mg per tablespoon = 64 mg; 64 ÷ 2 dough balls = 32 mg per pizza; 32 ÷ 8 slices ≈ 4 mg per slice at most. The true amount depends on the potency of the cannabis in your oil and on losses from decarboxylation and infusion. Start with one slice (half if you're new) and wait at least 2 hours before having more. Label the frozen dough and any leftovers as infused, and keep them away from children and pets.

Centers for Disease Control and Prevention: Cannabis and Poisoning (February 15, 2024)
USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service: Leftovers and Food Safety

review.summary: 14 claims checked: 14 ok, 0 fixed. Dose math, the brownie-stability study, the crust-temperature reasoning, bake and dough-handling times, leftovers and the High Society line all hold.

claims.claim: Dose math: 2 tablespoons at about 32 mg = 64 mg; / 2 dough balls = 32 mg per pizza; / 8 slices = about 4 mg per slice at most (body, dosing note)

claims.claim: Have one slice (half if you're new), then wait (at least) 2 hours
claims.source: https://www.cdc.gov/cannabis/health-effects/poisoning.html (WebFetch): 'Take from 30 minutes to 2 hours to feel intoxicating effects.'

claims.claim: A lab study of THC brownies found baking didn't degrade the THC (FAQ)
claims.source: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27798074/ (Wolf 2017, abstract via E-utilities): 'the process used to prepare and bake the brownie control material did not degrade the THC or CBD'

claims.claim: At 450°F the oven air is hot, but the inside of the crust stays far cooler and the bake is short (FAQ)
claims.source: https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/blog/2017/04/07/using-a-thermometer-with-yeast-bread (WebFetch): 'Most loaves and rolls will indeed be done when they register 190°F at their center'; 'bread's interior temperature will never rise above 212°F, since that's the boiling point of water'; the bake is 12 to 15 minutes

claims.claim: Some loss is still possible, so read the per-slice number as a ceiling (FAQ)
claims.source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5549281/ (Wang 2016, full text via Europe PMC): THC peaked at 145°C, then 'a significant loss at longer times possibly due to evaporation of Δ9-THC'

claims.claim: Bloom the yeast in water at about 110°F for 5 to 10 minutes, until foamy
claims.source: Fleischmann's Active Dry Yeast label directions (WebSearch over retailer listings; the pages refuse WebFetch): water at 100 to 110°F, add a teaspoon of sugar and let it stand 10 minutes

claims.claim: Ingredient: 1 envelope of active dry yeast is 2 1/4 teaspoons
claims.source: Fleischmann's product information (WebSearch over the Lowe's Foods listing that reproduces the packaging): one 1/4-ounce envelope equals 2 1/4 teaspoons of active dry yeast; this ingredient line was reworded by another editor at 14:33, before this check

claims.claim: Preheat the stone or sheet at 450°F for at least 30 minutes; bake a 12-inch pizza 12 to 15 minutes
claims.source: https://insanelygoodrecipes.com/how-long-to-cook-homemade-pizza-at-450/ (WebFetch): 'Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until the cheese has melted.'; 'Place a pizza stone (if using) in the oven to preheat.'

claims.claim: Freeze the dough once it has doubled; thaw overnight in the fridge and let it sit out an hour before shaping (FAQ)
claims.source: https://natashaskitchen.com/wprm_print/how-to-freeze-pizza-dough (WebFetch): freeze after fermentation, 'thaw in the refrigerator overnight (8-12 hours)', 'Keep dough at room temperature for 1 hour before baking.'

claims.claim: Eat leftover slices within 3 to 4 days
claims.source: https://www.fsis.usda.gov/food-safety/safe-food-handling-and-preparation/food-safety-basics/leftovers-and-food-safety (WebSearch on fsis.usda.gov): 'Leftovers can be kept in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 days or frozen for 3 to 4 months.'; https://extension.illinois.edu/food-safety/leftovers (WebFetch): 'Use refrigerated leftover food within 3-4 days.'

claims.claim: Keep it all away from kids and pets; poison control is 1-800-222-1222
claims.source: https://www.cdc.gov/cannabis/health-effects/poisoning.html: 'poison control center at 1-800-222-1222'; 'out of the reach and sight of children and pets'

claims.claim: The true amount depends on the cannabis's potency and on decarboxylation and infusion losses (dosing note)

review.notes: Independent fact-check: Wolf 2017 abstract through NCBI E-utilities (its full text is not open, so its oven settings are unknown; the FAQ already reads the per-slice number as a ceiling); Wang 2016 full text through Europe PMC; CDC, King Arthur (bread interior temperature), Insanely Good Recipes (450°F bake) and Natasha's Kitchen (frozen dough) opened with WebFetch; the Fleischmann's label (100 to 110°F, 10 minutes) and the USDA FSIS leftovers line confirmed by WebSearch (retailer and FSIS pages refuse WebFetch). One dose point at a time is kept as the default (brief). High Society appears once: order flower ahead for curbside pickup. Writer's notes: A full-strength crust plus full-strength honey is never the default: plain hot honey on an infused crust, canna-honey only on a plain or light crust. The word "rise" is avoided for the dough ("double in size"). FAQ idea "How do I dose pizza by the slice?" is answered in the dosing section. High Society appears once (order ahead, curbside pickup).
